text.tspan: A local change reaches the server and other devices
After any mutating command, the post-run hook runs one push-and-pull round. The server logs events idempotently, materializes them into the live project database, and notifies browser clients.
Read sync_state; check kill switch, feature flag,
Closed gate returns immediately with pending count 0;
Push batch (≤500) with retry until the 6s budget
Writer role confirmed, rate limit applied
Duplicates are acked with their existing server_seq so
Apply accepted events past the applied_events
Acks with server_seq; sync cursor updated
Pull after last_server_seq, excluding this device
Runs outside the CLI write lock. Local rows modified since
the last sync are recorded in sync_conflicts instead of
Warn only if changes are still pending
